title: Honeywell Technologies Launches Forge Plant Cognition with Dangote, Built with NVIDIA AI and Dell Technologies Capabilities
summary: Based on preliminary estimates, Forge Plant Cognition could deliver more than $60 million in gross operational benefits at Dangote’s Lekki refinery at full capacity Physical AI platform combines deep industrial expertise and automation to unlock greater plant performance CHARLOTTE, N.C.
